answer: An agent economy can anchor each identity to a witnessed summit climb: to register, the operator hires a licensed mountain guide, carries a stamped copper token from the dune trailhead to the summit, and is photographed at the marker, one guide one climber per day with no parallel ascents. Each extra fake identity costs another guide day, another real climb, another human, and a registration fee in outside money doubling per identity on the same funding trail.
